home.faqDesc: Everything you need to know about our services
home.faq1Q: What is your MOQ for custom orders?
home.faq1A: Our minimum order quantity varies by product type. For CNC machining, MOQ starts from 1 piece for prototypes. For injection molding, MOQ is typically 500 pieces. Contact us for specific requirements.
home.faq2Q: What certifications do your products have?
home.faq2A: We hold ISO 9001:2015, CE, and FDA certifications. All products undergo rigorous quality inspection and come with full material traceability and test reports.
home.faq3Q: What is the typical lead time?
home.faq3A: Prototype samples: 7-15 days. Mass production: 15-45 days depending on complexity and quantity. Rush orders available for urgent requirements.
home.faq4A: Yes, we provide full OEM and ODM services including design optimization, prototyping, tooling, production, and custom packaging with your branding.
home.faq5A: We support FOB, CIF, DDP, and express shipping. We work with major logistics partners for reliable worldwide delivery with real-time tracking.
home.faq6Q: How can I request a sample?
home.faq6A: Contact our sales team with your specifications. We typically produce samples within 7-15 days. Sample costs may be refundable against bulk orders.

privateLabel.heroSubtitle: Launch your own brand with proven formulas, custom packaging, and low MOQ.
privateLabel.whyDesc: Start your oral care brand without the R&D cost and time.
privateLabel.why1Desc: Start with as low as 5,000 units. No need for formula development.
privateLabel.why2Desc: From concept to shelf in 4-6 weeks. Proven formulas ready to go.
privateLabel.why3Desc: Your logo, your design, your brand identity on quality products.
privateLabel.why4Desc: Start small and scale as your brand grows. Flexible MOQ tiers.
privateLabel.processDesc: 4 simple steps to launch your brand
privateLabel.step1Desc: Select from 50+ proven oral care formulas.
privateLabel.step2Desc: Send us your logo, colors, and packaging preferences.
privateLabel.step3Desc: Receive samples within 7 days. Approve before production.
privateLabel.step4Desc: We manufacture, package, and ship to your door.
privateLabel.productsDesc: All our products can be customized with your brand
privateLabel.moqDesc: Flexible tiers to match your business stage
privateLabel.faq1Q: What is the minimum order quantity?
privateLabel.faq1A: Our minimum MOQ for private label is 5,000 units per SKU.
privateLabel.faq2A: Samples are ready within 7-10 business days after confirming your design.
privateLabel.faq3Q: Can I use my own formula?
privateLabel.faq3A: Yes, you can choose from our 50+ proven formulas or provide your own for custom manufacturing.
privateLabel.faq4A: We offer custom tubes, boxes, caps, and labels. You can also use our standard packaging with your logo.
privateLabel.faq5A: Yes, our design team can help create your packaging artwork for a small fee, or you can provide your own design files.
privateLabel.ctaDesc: Tell us about your project and get a custom quote within 24 hours.
